summary: Space Exploration Technologies Corp. (SpaceX) completed its acquisition of Anysphere, Inc. (Cursor) via a merger, effective August 14, 2026. Cursor stockholders received 389,289,254 SpaceX Class A common shares, implying a $60.0 billion equity value, plus additional shares for vested RSUs and cash in lieu of fractional shares. Unvested Cursor RSUs and options were assumed as SpaceX RSUs and options. The shares were issued in a private placement under Section 4(a)(2). The Merger Agreement was previously filed on June 16, 2026. Watch for post-closing integration and any earnout or indemnification adjustments.
